sc-county-council.summary: Your County Council card names whoever won each seat at its most recent election, which is not always who holds it today. Where the county's own page names someone else, the card shows both.
sc-county-council.why: The names come from the State Election Commission's certified results. No statewide list says who holds each seat now, so a resignation, appointment or special election since then is not shown.
sc-county-council.wanted: A statewide list of who holds each county council seat today, or each county's own member list in a form this app can read every week.

sc-judicial-circuit-officers.summary: Your Judicial Circuit card says which circuit you are in, how many judges are elected for it and who elects them, and names neither the judges nor the solicitor yet.
sc-judicial-circuit-officers.why: No list of South Carolina's circuit judges or solicitors by circuit has been read yet.
sc-judicial-circuit-officers.wanted: Nothing from a reader yet. The court system's own list of judges and the solicitors' list are the next places this project will read.

sc-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which South Carolina city or town you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
sc-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of South Carolina's mayors and council members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
sc-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of mayors and council members, or each city's own published list.

sc-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people who run it.
sc-school-board-members.why: South Carolina's school boards are not all chosen the same way, and no statewide list of their members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
sc-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

sc-school-board-who-votes.summary: For 115 school board districts on 16 boards, the card cannot say whether only the district's voters or every voter in the school district elect its member.
sc-school-board-who-votes.why: Each South Carolina school board is set by its own act of the General Assembly, and these 16 acts say only that a member is elected from, or lives in, a district. They never say who votes.
sc-school-board-who-votes.wanted: One statement for every school board of who votes for each seat. Whoever runs each election already knows it, since every ballot has to carry the right seats.
